findings.title: Regenerated sprites.json order mismatches sprites.odin's positional texture<->bbox binding — silent sprite corruption at the first follow-up re-render, blessed by the T2 re-bless
findings.detail: MECHANICALLY VERIFIED (Blender 5.2.0 sandbox render): new main() emits order [...,dc,small_biz,campus,puck_1..3]; renderer loads textures by its pinned files[] (puck_1..3 at 6-8, small_biz 9, campus 10) but binds bboxes[i] from order[i] positionally. Indices 6-10 cross-bind five sprites; all values pass the value-range checks silently; palcheck pins palette (flat fills keep colors under a wrong crop), so the T2 re-bless would bless the corrupted crops as new goldens.
findings.recommended_fix: Emit names in the pinned files[] order (append small_biz/campus AFTER the pucks, or drive names from the same pinned list), and add a pin asserting script-emitted order == sprites.odin files[].

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
findings.detail: P0 pipeline contract (sidecar order <-> renderer pin) has ZERO coverage — nothing in ci-local gates can catch the order drift; determinism validation exists only as PR-body prose. P0 <100% -> FAIL.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a gate/pin: emitted sprites.json order must equal the renderer's pinned files[] (and bbox sanity vs committed sheet when no geometry change is declared).

findings.title: Determinism claim mis-worded in committed docs: implies the CURRENT (reworked) script re-renders byte-identical to the committed sprites
findings.detail: MECHANICALLY VERIFIED: the TRUE claim is about the OLD script (old-script re-render == committed PNGs decoded-pixel-identical; old-script regen == committed sprites.json — both PASS in sandbox). The NEW script renders different geometry (house 84x79 vs committed 92x90, host 104x116 vs 132x92...) — as worded ('the current script... decoded pixels byte-identical to the committed sprites') the claim is false and could bait a no-re-bless commit of new PNGs.
findings.recommended_fix: Re-word: attribute pixel-identity to the pre-rework geometry ('a re-render with unchanged SPEC values is pixel-deterministic'); keep the old-script proof as the evidence.

findings.title: Outline ring width stated two incompatible ways across the two contract docs
findings.location: assets/blender/README.md:26 vs docs/silhouette-spec.md:29 vs tools/gen_sprites.py OUTLINE_RING
findings.detail: README: 'footprint + ~0.03'; spec §0: 'footprint + ~0.06'; code: fw + 2*OUTLINE_RING (=+0.06 total, 0.03/side). The user is sculpting against these tables live in Blender; the defining MM edge dimension disagrees 2x between the two docs.
findings.recommended_fix: Pick one convention (per-side 0.03 / total 0.06), state it identically in README + spec §0.

findings.title: Spec §1 says house ridge runs 'along the long axis'; the shipped gable default puts it along Y — the SHORT axis (0.62 x 0.56)
findings.detail: HOUSE_SIZE bw=0.62(X) > bd=0.56(Y); add_gable's ridge runs along Y = the short axis. A user sculpting to §1 orients the ridge 90 deg off the KYLE-default render.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the spec line ('ridge along the short axis / along Y') or flip the gable — one of them must move.

findings.title: Render contract pins 'ORTHO ~66 deg tilt' but actual per-sprite elevations run 48.7-66.9 deg (campus 48.7, dc 54.2)
findings.location: docs/silhouette-spec.md:26 + assets/blender/README.md:23 vs tools/gen_sprites.py:140-141 (aim: location y=-4.5*pad)
findings.detail: MECHANICALLY COMPUTED: elevation = atan(10/(4.5*pad)) per pad (house 63.3, host 61.6, dc 54.2, small_biz 61.6, campus 48.7, puck 66.9). Pre-existing quirk, ruled left-as-is — but 'varies slightly' is a 17-deg spread and both contract tables state ~66 deg flat; a user matching §0 in Blender diverges from the script render for the biggest terminals.
findings.recommended_fix: State the real per-sprite tilt range (or per-sprite tilts) in §0/README; drop the flat ~66 deg claim.

findings.title: Spec §2 promises a 'Sculpted' fold-in path the tool does not support: no bbox-only mode; re-running gen_sprites.py overwrites the user's exported PNGs
findings.detail: Way-2 says 'export the PNGs yourself; the minion folds them in (bbox regen + T2 re-bless)' — but main() always re-renders all 11 sprites from the SPEC table, and README forbids hand-editing sprites.json. The promised path needs a --bbox-only mode (or documented fold-in procedure) that does not exist yet.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a bbox-only mode (skip render, recompute content_bbox from existing PNGs) or reword §2 way-2 to 'lands with the fold-in commit'.

findings.title: Pipeline 'validated' claim has no durable in-repo artifact; SPEC-table drift is invisible until the single wave-end re-bless
findings.detail: The determinism proof lives only in PR-body prose. No gate re-derives sprites.json or compares emitted order/bboxes against the renderer's expectations, so a SPEC edit that drifts the contract fails nothing until the re-bless blesses it.
findings.recommended_fix: Wire a small check into ci-local (e.g. re-run gen_sprites in CI-blenderless mode is impossible — instead pin order + bbox plausibility in a harness test).

findings.title: PUCK_TIER[ports] direct index KeyError-trap + {4:1,8:2,16:3} literal duplicated at the call site
findings.detail: The SPEC table is the advertised fill-in-the-blanks surface; adding a tier key hits KeyError only at render time, and the ports->suffix map exists twice.

findings.title: mat_hex silently mis-parses wrong-length hex strings (slices, no length check)
findings.detail: A 5- or 7-char SPEC hex renders a wrong color with no error — the fill-in-the-blanks surface accepts free-text hexes.
findings.recommended_fix: len(h)==6 assert (or explicit parse error naming the constant).

findings.title: Committed docs embed the developer's absolute filesystem paths (/Users/moses/...)
findings.detail: Machine-local worktree/output paths in repo-committed docs go stale for any other checkout and leak the dev layout.

findings.title: .blend commit policy lacks the embedded-scripts auto-run caveat
findings.detail: README invites committing .blend files; Blender can embed scripts that auto-execute on open with auto-run enabled. One caveat line closes it.
findings.recommended_fix: Add: 'open foreign .blend with auto-run disabled' note.

findings.title: README export-name list cites the sprites.odin pin but lists a different order than the pin (and than the script's emitted order)
findings.detail: README lists small_biz/campus BEFORE puck_1..3 while claiming 'pinned by app/render/sprites.odin' (which pins pucks at 6-8). Third variant of the order story — same root as the blocker.
findings.recommended_fix: List the names in the actual pinned order.

findings.title: Per-sprite camera pads live outside the SPEC table; an oversized SPEC footprint silently clips at the 256px frame edge
findings.detail: content_bbox scans whatever pixels exist — content touching the frame edge is indistinguishable from a correct render; nothing warns.
findings.recommended_fix: Warn (or fail) when a bbox touches the canvas edge; move pads next to the SPEC sizes.
